author: TEDx Talks
description:
When the stakes rise, we prepare, we control, we hide… and end up sounding like a robot in the exact moments we most want to connect. Samara Bay has discovered that the speakers who move us and make life changing impact aren't the most polished or the most confident — they've made one radical decision. It's simpler than you think, and it changes everything. 

Samara Bay is the author of the #1 bestselling Permission to Speak and a professor at USC Annenberg. She is a private advisor to movie stars, global business leaders, rising athletes, and candidates for office — all on the same thing: how to show up fully in the moments that matter most. 

This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: The one thing every great speaker does (and no one teaches) | Samara Bay | TEDxCulverCity

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Dr Naa Adzoa Adzeley Boi-Dsane (a Ghanaian medical doctor)  walked into her consulting room with a pen and paper in hand, and the next set of events in that room changed the trajectory of everything. She made a deliberate decision that ultimately led her beyond the medical field and into classrooms, competition arenas and the corridors of power.
She poses thought-provoking questions and challenges a system that has refused to understand Ghana's community of over 110,000 Deaf individuals. The truths are shocking, but what she did about it is inspiring. 
Catch the unforgettable moments in this talk.
Are you uncomfortable enough to make a change yet? Naa Adzoa Adzeley Boi-Dsane is a medical doctor, writer, independent researcher and a passionate advocate for the Deaf community.

She created her SignWithAdzeley YouTube channel where she delivers health education and explains her scientific research using sign language and voice.

She also created the Abacus and Science Competition for Dea
title: The Ghanians we refuse to hear | Dr. Naa Adzoa Adzeley Boi-Dsane | TEDxUniversityofCapeCoast

author: TEDx Talks
description: Community vs. Community. In the digital age, a community is no longer defined simply by sharing the same physical space. People are freer than ever to find and stay connected with those who share their values and ideas, regardless of distance. Living outside major cities offers a unique opportunity to build and sustain these hybrid communities—where local belonging and global connections come together. I have a professional background in international relations, which I now apply in the technology sector. My work is focused on building bridges between Armenia and international organizations, governments and tech communities, contributing to Armenia’s recognition as a technology hub. I believe that technology is reshaping global power dynamics, and I strive to make tech diplomacy a more visible field. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: Why innovation is a team sport | Anahit Budaghyan | TEDxDebet

description:
In this inspiring talk, Angelos Y. Pomevo reshapes our perception of dyslexia and challenges the traditional approach to learning differences. 

He urges African educators, parents, and policymakers to cultivate inclusive spaces that value real-world problem-solving. As the Fourth Industrial Revolution (4IR) progresses, skills like creativity, innovation, and big-picture strategy are highly recommended over simple memorization.

Born into a multicultural family, Angelos brings a personal passion for diversity, and a profound understanding of the distinct challenges individuals face across different cultural and cognitive backgrounds. Angelos Y. Pomevo is a polyglot and trained professional speaker with over 8 years of working experience in FinTech across West Africa.

title: This is why a dyslexic mind is genius! | Angelos Y. Pomevo | TEDxUniversityofCapeCoast

author: TEDx Talks
description:
La Compagnie La Machine met en scène dans la rue, ses machines géantes qui transforment le quotidien en théâtre vivant. Nées d’un savoir-faire mêlant sculpture, menuiserie, mécanique et robotique, elles changent notre regard sur la ville et rassemblent autour d’une expérience partagée. Après un parcours dédié au développement de carrière de jeunes artistes en musiques actuelles, elle dirige la communication, les partenariats et la diffusion de la Compagnie La Machine. 
Elle accompagne le rayonnement des créations de François Delaroziere en France et à l’international depuis 17 ans. Passionnée d'art et plus particulièrement des expressions artistiques dans l'espace public, elle révèle lors de ce Tedx Nantes, le procédé de construction des machines, véritables oeuvres d'art en mouvement. Elle montre aussi que ces oeuvres et leur poésie peuvent être un bien commun fédérateur. 

Réalisation : Nicolas Salet
Captation Vidéo : Lumisson 
Montage post-production : Tom Racine (Lumisson)
Photos
title: La rue, un théâtre pour tous | Fredette Lampre | TEDxNantes

author: TEDx Talks
description:
For every five skilled tradespeople who retire, only two enter to replace them. That math is why you can't get a plumber to call back, why home repairs cost more, and why our roads, bridges, and power grids are starting to strain. In this practical, urgent talk, Steve Turner argues that reviving the trades isn't nostalgia — it's how America protects its economy, infrastructure, and national security.
 Steve Turner is the founder and CEO of Bring Back the Trades, a New Hampshire-based nonprofit dedicated to restoring respect, opportunity, and awareness around America's skilled trades workforce. With more than 36 years of experience as a small business owner in the auto and marine upholstery industry, Turner saw firsthand the shortage of skilled workers and the declining emphasis on vocational education in schools. title: How shop class became a national security issue | Steve Turner | TEDxPortsmouth

author: TEDx Talks
description:
¿Qué hace un director de orquesta? Ezequiel Silberstein lo explica partiendo de una idea: los directores son artesanos del tiempo. La batuta como "máquina del tiempo", el significado del tempo en la música y cómo se le da vida a una obra. Ezequiel Silberstein es Director de Orquesta y, desde 2024, Director Principal Invitado de la Orquesta Nacional de Música Argentina “Juan de Dios Filiberto”. Se formó en la UNA y en la Universidad de Tel Aviv y dirigió desde clásicos del ballet en el Teatro Colón hasta conciertos sinfónicos de Star Wars, Pixar y National Geographic.

Colaboró con artistas como Ricky Martín, Abel Pintos y sus recientes trabajos discográficos incluyen colaboraciones con Fito Paez en el disco La Conquista del Espacio, ganador de un premio Grammy y dos premios Grammy Latinos; y las orquestaciones para el álbum sinfónico Futurología Arlt (ganador de un Premio Gardel).

Debutó en el Carnegie Hall de Nueva York y ganó un Cóndor de Plata por su trabajo en cine y música sinfó
title: Tempo | Ezequiel Silberstein | TEDxRíodelaPlata

author: TEDx Talks
description:
What if confidence is not something we find, but something we build through action? At 49, he entered an Ironman 70.3 terrified and unsure he belonged. 

Through fear, fatigue, time cutoffs, and moments of gratitude, he discovered that identity changes when we create new evidence about who we are. 

This talk reveals how one courageous yes can challenge an old story and begin reshaping the person we believe ourselves to be. John Ribeiro is an executive coach, certified Master NLP Practitioner, and ICF ACC who partners with leaders and organizations to unlock potential and elevate performance. Drawing on corporate leadership experience, he designs transformative workshops and coaching experiences that help individuals thrive, lead boldly, and create lasting impact worldwide and sustainably. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: The Identity-Shaping Power of Yes | John Ribeiro | TEDxMississauga
